description: This file contains utility functions and classes for managing iframe-based challenge previews, including scroll management, test runner setup, frame creation, and error handling within the FreeCodeCamp challenge environment.

classes.name: ScrollManager
classes.description: Manages scroll position within iframe previews, allowing saving, restoring, and registering scroll event listeners.

methods.name: getPreviewScrollPosition
methods.description: Returns the current saved scroll position.

methods.name: setPreviewScrollPosition
methods.description: Sets the scroll position to a specified value.

methods.name: registerScrollEventListener
methods.description: Adds a scroll event listener to an iframe to track scroll position.

methods.name: restorePreviewScrollPosition
methods.description: Restores the iframe's scroll position to the saved value.

methods.name: runTestsInTestFrame
methods.description: Executes tests within a specified test iframe, returning test results.

methods.name: prepTestRunner
methods.description: Prepares and initializes the test runner environment within a document.

methods.name: runPythonInFrame
methods.description: Runs Python code inside a specified iframe's PythonDocument.

methods.name: createMainPreviewFramer
methods.description: Creates a frame handler for the main challenge preview iframe.

methods.name: createProjectPreviewFramer
methods.description: Creates a frame handler for the project preview iframe.
